summary: Sequans Communications filed a Form 6-K announcing completion of full redemption of all remaining convertible debt issued July 2025, funded by sale of a portion of its Bitcoin holdings. The company now holds ~658 Bitcoin, all unrestricted. No price per share, premium, or implied value stated. Board/CEO recommended as pure-play focus on IoT semiconductors. Mechanical: debt fully redeemed via Bitcoin monetization, balance sheet simplified, no external financing. Structural notes: debt-free, treasury strategy ended, remaining Bitcoin monetization planned. What to watch: execution on 5G roadmap and cash burn trajectory; risk-arb angle minimal as this is a capital structure cleanup, not a transaction with spread.
